title: MedProb：用于医学问答的视觉语言模型内部表示探测
summary: MedProb 是一个轻量级探测框架，从冻结的视觉语言模型表示中预测医学多项选择问答答案，无需微调或生成。在多个基准上优于提示和医学VLM，并揭示小模型包含更多可恢复信号，且医学适应不总改善线性可解码性。
summary_en: MedProb is a lightweight probing framework that predicts medical multiple-choice VQA answers from frozen VLM representations without fine-tuning or generation. It outperforms prompting and medical VLMs on benchmarks, revealing that smaller models contain more recoverable signal and medical adaptation doesn't consistently improve linear decodability.
